*581Appeal from the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.

The court declined to hear further argument.

Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Schlosser v. Hemphill, 198 U. S. 173; California Consolidated Mining Company v. Manley, ante, p. 579, and cases cited.
